fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (MRVL +9.49%) fell 25.6% in October but is recovering from AI stock selling concerns, targeting 2027 revenue growth of 45% to $12 billion and 2028 growth of 50% to $20 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Marvell's acquisition of Lumentum ($115 billion, expected H1 2028) raises concerns about existing shareholder dilution, but investors are focused on 2031 revenue target of $80 billion for long-term growth.
